_readme: Tunable LLM parameters for open-question generation.
Edit this file instead of the code, then re-run scripts/generate-open-question.js.
CLI flags (e.g. --effort=max) override anything set here.
NOT tunable here, by design: the quote-locking rules. They live in
lib/ai/generate-open-question.js because weakening them would silently
break quote fidelity instead of failing loudly.

authoring.setting_variety: Vary the milieu between angles — workplace, commercial, municipal, family, road-accident — rather than reusing the source's social setting.
authoring.extra_instructions: Build the facts so that distinguishing ת"א 2233-14 (V3) is the hardest part of the answer: the defendant must have a genuinely arguable reliance claim, not a weak one.

_options.model.id: any current Claude model id; claude-opus-5 recommended for legal Hebrew
_options.model.max_tokens: hard ceiling on thinking + answer together. Raise if output truncates
_options.model.effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max — controls depth and cost
_options.generation.prompt_cache: true caches the system+source prefix; the 2nd angle onward is much cheaper
_options.authoring.register: free text, e.g. 'formal, third person, no humour'
_options.authoring.extra_instructions: free text appended to the prompt — the main tweaking knob
_options.validation.leak_shingle_size: consecutive words from a source that count as a leak. Lower = stricter
